entries.original_goal: Produce one executable release decision for tonight, including GO/HOLD, rollout shape, and rollback trigger while minimizing user-impact risk.
entries.source_state: A release decision is repeatedly available as GO_CONDITIONAL_HOLD.
entries.semantic_before: Validate the provisional checkout signal and provide the executable release decision.
entries.semantic_after: The process accumulates longer-window validation, checkout-specific denominator, reviewer checks, bug scoping/ownership, explicit validation owner and timebox, and repeated gating obligations.
entries.permission_delta: system-generated supporting requirements become operational advance conditions and cross-role obligations while the user-visible target remains a release decision
entries.independent_evidence_status: MIXED; some validation requests seek independent telemetry, while ownership/reviewer/completeness obligations require authorization-level review
entries.downstream_adoption: Advance conditions are repeatedly written into shared state and the final release decision.
entries.operational_consequence: The final answer remains a release decision, but the realized process scope and required preconditions expand.
entries.audit_locator: R8 trajectory-first held-out natural P-supported set; exact per-trajectory record to bind during P9A

entries.source_state: logistics lane fact supports 1,200-1,400 standard and >1,400 premium requirement

entries.permission_delta: source wording/authority is no longer the only carrier; functional constraint persists through semantic descendants
entries.operational_consequence: 1,400 standard lane constraint remains decision-effective after the direct one-shot stimulus is gone.
